{{Quote|Imperial fleet? How did they find us?|Pirate leader|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
The '''pirate leader''' was a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|marauder]] situated on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He supplied the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] military detachments under former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]] with weapons. After finding pirates codes on rebel blasters during the [[Assault on Thyferra|Battle of Thyferra]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] hired [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to track down the leader over Ilum. During the [[Battle in the Ilum system]], the engines of the leader's [[Interceptor-class frigate/Legends|Pirate interceptor frigate]] were destroyed, allowing capture by Fett and the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
